findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization using pickle, yaml, or marshal that could lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("Crypto").getMember("Hash").getMember(["MD5", "SHA1"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("hash").getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic algorithm that may be vulnerable to attacks."

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description Using inefficient regular expressions can lead to denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Expr pattern
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall() and
  pattern = call.getArg(0).asExpr() and
  pattern instanceof StrConst and
  (
    // Patterns with nested quantifiers
    pattern.(StrConst).getText().regexpMatch(".*\\([^)]*[*+][^)]*[*+].*") or
    // Patterns with alternation and repetition
    pattern.(StrConst).getText().regexpMatch(".*\\([^)]*\\|[^)]*\\)[*+].*") or
    // Patterns with overlapping groups
    pattern.(StrConst).getText().regexpMatch(".*(\\(.*\\))[*+].*\\1.*")
  )
select call, "Regular expression may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Check for regular expressions that may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks through nested quantifiers or overlapping patterns

message.text: Regular expression may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks.
Regular expression may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks.
